_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

wipUnitName.description: Display value of wipUnitId, copied from u_mes_plan_wipUnit.recordNo

serialNumberName.description: Display value of serialNumberId, copied from u_mes_trac_serialNumber.recordNo

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

productVariantName.description: Display value of productVariantId, copied from u_mes_prod_productVariant.name

productionOrderName.description: Display value of productionOrderId, copied from u_mes_plan_productionOrder.recordNo

customerName.description: Display value of customerId, copied from u_mes_mast_customer.name

builtAt.description: Date and time when the record was built. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

torqueTorqueResultId.description: Reference to u_mes_perf_torqueResult._id: torque torque result

torqueTorqueResultName.description: Display value of torqueTorqueResultId, copied from u_mes_perf_torqueResult.recordNo

leakTestLeakTestResultId.description: Reference to u_mes_perf_leakTestResult._id: leak test leak test result

leakTestLeakTestResultName.description: Display value of leakTestLeakTestResultId, copied from u_mes_perf_leakTestResult.recordNo

leakTestLeakRate.description: Measured leak rate at the high-pressure stage (sccm)

bodyLotName.description: Display value of bodyLotId, copied from u_mes_plan_lot.recordNo

castingLotName.description: Display value of castingLotId, copied from u_mes_plan_lot.recordNo

heatTreatmentLotId.description: Reference to u_mes_plan_lot._id: heat treatment lot

heatTreatmentLotName.description: Display value of heatTreatmentLotId, copied from u_mes_plan_lot.recordNo

deviationPermitName.description: Display value of deviationPermitId, copied from u_mes_qual_deviationPermit.title

containerName.description: Display value of containerId, copied from u_mes_plan_container.recordNo

shipmentName.description: Display value of shipmentId, copied from u_mes_matl_shipment.recordNo

finalReleaseById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'final release'

finalReleaseBy.description: Display name of the user in finalReleaseById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

finalReleaseAt.description: Final release date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

recordHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the frozen record

genealogyComplete.description: True when every traceable BOM component is linked

missingComponentCount.description: Number of traceable BOM components not linked

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
